acceptanceCriteria: A non-NATIVE record carrying `obligations` is refused by the internal/taskman reader with a named code, with a regression test, or the TOL spec records that it is tolerated and why.
Tasks and Core readers agree on the rule (one test per side).
body: Suspected defect found by the V1-1022 lane (2026-10-08, lane head f44c5cf4): the Tasks side writes the optional `obligations` record member (TOL-V0) only on NATIVE tickets, but the Core reader in internal/taskman does not refuse the member on an IMPORT or other non-NATIVE record. Expected: a non-NATIVE record carrying `obligations` is refused (or the spec states it is accepted and ignored). Actual: accepted silently, by the lane's code reading; no reproduction yet.
